company_name: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. Common Shares
title: Metalla Reports Record Financial Results for the Second Quarter of 2026 and Provides Asset Updates
summary: Vancouver, Canada: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. (“Metalla” or the “Company”) (TSXV: MTA) (NYSE American: MTA) announces its operating and financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. For complete details of the condensed interim consolidated financial statements and accompanying management's discussion and analysis for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, please see the Company's filings on SEDAR+ (www.sedarplus.ca) or EDGAR (www.sec.gov). Shareholders are encouraged to visit the Company's website at www.metallaroyalty.com.
